title: The Laugh
source_seed: Ugra Tara: the fierce laugh of the dhyana verses
caption_hook: Ugra Tara: the one who laughs at what frightens you.

shots.camera: Eye level, front-facing, three-quarter-length framing from the reference portrait, with one slow, small push-in throughout and the crown and golden sun disc centered and fully framed.
shots.action: Her stern gaze holds the viewer, then Her chin lifts slightly and She gives a brief, fierce, confident laugh, Her shoulders and the skull garland shaking with it and the gold jewelry glinting. As the laugh ends She settles into a composed, steady look and the vertical third eye glows softly. Her hair settles under natural gravity.
shots.purpose: The fierce laugh is Tara-specific (Ugra Tara); the settling look and third eye glow show the fear dispelled.
